item.title: Sanju Samson overtakes Virat Kohli as India seal sixth T20 World Cup semifinal appearance
item.description: KOLKATA: Indian batter Sanju Samson overtook Virat Kohli’s record, scoring the highest individual score for India during a successful run-chase in the history of the T20 World Cups. item.title: Security tightened after protests in parts of Delhi over killing of Iran’s supreme leader
item.description: NEW DELHI: Security was heightened across several parts of the national capital following protests and gatherings held to mourn the death of Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, police said on Sunday. item.description: SRINAGAR: Authorities on Monday imposed severe restrictions on the movement of people in parts of Kashmir where massive street protests were witnessed over the killing of Iran’s supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in a joint strike by the US and Israel. item.title: Sensex, Nifty crash in early trade as Middle East crisis deepens
item.description: MUMBAI: Benchmark equity indices Sensex and Nifty crashed in early trade on Monday tracking a sharp spike in crude oil prices amid escalating tensions in the Middle East. item.description: NEW DELHI: The Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) has issued a cautionary letter to all state governments, urging heightened vigilance against potential communal violence in India following the recent military strikes by the United States and Israel on Iran.
